name: steward-infra
description: Measure what the executor host can do for the Steward: the coder binaries, node, git, the MCP endpoint, the pack repository, disk. provision stores the MCP token in the vault for the lanes; pause and resume stop and restore the whole model.

name: steward-observe
description: Measure the model the Steward lives in: every lane's status, kind, schedule and fires, errors, contract misses, stranded tokens, tokens per place, cost per lane; writes health, lanes, the model map and the budget, and starts an iteration when nothing waits for the person.

name: steward-context
description: Renders the brief a judgement lane reads: charter, health, lanes, map, knowledge, plan, history; plus the person's answer for a spec brief.

name: steward-gate
description: The policy gate over a change spec: closed kinds, the protected set, the scope, the budget, the autonomy level. Approves, asks the person, or refuses with a reason.

name: steward-apply
description: Applies an approved spec with the configured headless coder inside the pack repository on a branch: sources edited, library inlined, pack built and packaged, version bumped, invariants checked, run recorded, verification queued.

name: steward-verify
description: Proves a built pack version: the protected set unchanged, the manifest invariants kept, the lint of every changed lane, then publish and install into the model and a smoke observation; rolls back to the previous version when the smoke fails.

name: steward-release
description: Merges the branch, tags the version, records the repository and the run, asks the brain to observe and starts the next iteration. rollback installs the previous version.

name: steward-brain
description: The brain: observe collects the signals of a released run and the model map; curate answers the curation contract (one-shot lane or headless agent); apply adds and retires facts, rewrites the plan, files decisions and questions; answer records the person's answer as a fact.
